name: resolve
summary: Settle the conflicts ara merge left in a document: ara resolve levels/a.scene --pick e_b2:name=theirs (or --ours / --theirs for all)
usage: ara resolve [OPTIONS] <FILE>

options.name: --ours
options.doc: Keep our side of every conflict not picked

options.name: --root <ROOT>
options.doc: Project root (default: the nearest ancestor with ara.project.json)

options.name: --theirs
options.doc: Keep their side of every conflict not picked

options.name: --author <AUTHOR>
options.doc: Who protocol commands are attributed to: human or agent:<name> (default: ARA_AUTHOR, else the agent running this CLI, else human)

options.name: --pick <PICKS>
options.doc: One conflict: <record>:<path>=ours|theirs|base (<record>=… for a whole record). Repeatable
